name: unified_safe_system_e2r_baseline_rescue_v2
motivation_boundary: V1 unconstrained LambdaRank is rejected because it destroyed EnzGFM early ranking despite improving AUROC. V2 changes the mechanism, not V1 hyperparameters.

development_split.type: strict protein+reaction entity-disjoint deterministic salted hash double-cold

experts.recipe_provenance: Exact previously frozen Gate-A/Gate-B clean recipe; no V2-specific backbone tuning.

rescue_mechanism.immutable_prefix: EnzGFM baseline ranks 1 through 9 are never changed.
rescue_mechanism.slot_candidates: EnzGFM baseline rank-10 candidate plus union of each additional expert Top-50, excluding baseline ranks 1-9.
rescue_mechanism.tail: After the selected rank-10 candidate, all remaining candidates retain exact EnzGFM relative order with the promoted candidate removed from its original location.
structural_invariants: At most one candidate is promoted into Top10

slot_ranker.cross_fit: For each held-out development fold, ranker trains only on slot groups from the other two folds.
features: four clipped Top-50 rank positions (51 if outside Top50)
EnzGFM score gap to baseline rank10
slot_ranker.labels: positive association labels only on ranker-training internal folds

confirmation_if_development_passes.base_experts: retrain same four fixed recipes only on frozen confirmation training partition
confirmation_if_development_passes.slot_ranker: fit one final ranker on all V2 development OOF slot groups only, then freeze its hash before confirmation scoring

forbidden: V1 folds 0/1/2 for V2 ranker fitting
